description:
Who We Are: 

 
 At Bandwidth , we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

 Because we own the network we build on, the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful. And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

 We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

 We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? #JoinTheBand 



 What We Are Looking For: 

 As a Software Engineer on our Voice team, you'll help build the systems that decide how calls are routed across Bandwidth's network and carriers around the world, and the data pipelines that keep those decisions accurate. You'll work on services that carry live traffic, so careful engineering and strong testing habits matter. We work AI-first: you'll use AI coding agents every day to learn the codebase, build and test faster, and automate the work around it.

 What You'll Do: 

 
 Help define features and their design with the team, then ship them end to end in the Java services that route calls, from tests through deployment and monitoring.

 Build and harden data pipelines that ingest, validate and publish large routing and pricing datasets, with automated checks that stop bad data before it reaches production.

 Design REST APIs and internal tools that make routing data safe and easy to manage, with the needs of the people and customers who rely on them in mind.

 Automate deployments, health checks and routine operations across VMs, Kubernetes and AWS.

 Use AI coding agents daily to explore unfamiliar code, write and refactor code and tests, analyze data and draft documentation, and verify every change before it ships.

 Bring new tools and technologies, including AI tooling, into the team when they solve a real problem without creating bigger ones.

 Investigate routing questions with real call and pricing data, help resolve production issues, and join the on-call rotation once ramped up.

 Write tests, documentation and runbooks for what you build, and review your teammates' code.

 
 What You Need: 

 
 2 - 4 years of professional software engineering experience, mainly backend, including features you helped design and shipped to production yourself.

 Experience delivering tasks with limited oversight, including working through unfamiliar problems on your own. You can walk us through an example.

 Proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, including writing unit and integration tests for the code you ship.

 Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code) in your day-to-day development. You can walk us through, or demonstrate live, how you use them and how you check their work.

 Strong SQL: you can write and optimize queries with complex joins and aggregations on large tables, and validate that the results are correct.

 Experience designing REST APIs, including versioning, error handling and idempotency.

 Working knowledge of Linux and scripting in Bash or Python.

 Experience deploying and debugging your own services using CI/CD pipelines and containers.

 Methodical debugging: you form a hypothesis, check it against logs, metrics and data, and explain the answer clearly.

 
 Bonus Points: 

 
 Telecom, VoIP or CPaaS experience, or familiarity with SIP, number portability, call routing, least-cost routing or carrier rate management.

 Experience building your own AI-powered tools, scripts or agent workflows.

 Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

 Experience with Ansible or other configuration management.

 Front-end experience.

 Experience with Go, AWS, or Datadog or similar observability tooling.

 
 The Whole Person Promise: 

 At Bandwidth, we’re pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our “Whole Person Promise.” We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

 
 100% company-paid Medical, Vision, & Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out-of-pocket expenses.

 All new hires receive four weeks of PTO.

 PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you’re embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email.

 Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.

 “Mahalo moments” program grants additional time off for life’s most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.

 90-Minute Workout Lunches and unlimited meetings with our very own nutritionist.

 
 
  

 Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you’re 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered ‘yes’ to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won’t want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

 Applicant Privacy Notice
